title: Controlled Shadow Sentinel and Accounting for Metered Duplication
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We currently lack a single, auditable service for duplicating live requests into safe test sandboxes with tenant-aware spend limits and deterministic sampling. Existing ad-hoc shadow paths risk unbounded cost and make it hard for platform teams and customers to safely validate model rollouts (canaries/A-B) against realistic traffic.

Goal: Ship a lightweight 'Shadow Sentinel' broker that performs safe duplication of requests with: deterministic sampling, per-tenant credit fencing, sandbox routing, payload redaction hooks, and cost/accounting telemetry. The Sentinel should integrate with existing routing policy rules and support both streaming and non-streaming paths.

Scope: MVP covers routing proxy insertion, sampling policies (fixed-rate, stratified by tenant), a credit ledger to stop duplication once tenant credits exhausted, simple tenant sandbox mapping, telemetry for token counts and estimated dollar cost, and a graceful fallback mode that disables duplication when budget/exceptions are triggered. Excludes automated model comparison dashboards (followup ticket).
tasks: Design Shadow Sentinel API and config format (sampling rules, tenant credits, sandbox mapping)
Implement duplication proxy with non-blocking fanout and backpressure handling
Add deterministic sampling library (seeded by request-id) and stratification by tenant weight
Create per-tenant credit ledger service with soft/hard limits and audit trail
Wire telemetry: per-request tokens, estimated cost, duplicated_request_id mapping
Integrate with rollout controller: allow canary/AB flows to enable sandbox targets
Add egress redaction hook for PII-sensitive tenants and opt-out flag
Implement admin UI toggles for emergency kill-switch and tenant quarantine
Write end-to-end tests and chaos scenarios (duplicate-failure, slow-sandbox, credit-exhaustion)
Prepare runbook and monitoring alerts for cost spikes and replication errors
acceptance_criteria: Shadow Sentinel duplicates requests with <= 5ms median additional upstream latency under normal load
Sampling decisions are deterministic and reproducible for a given request-id and policy
Tenant duplication stops immediately when credit balance hits zero and audit log shows stop event
Estimated duplication cost surfaced in console per-tenant and aligns within 10% of actual invoice for test runs
No production request path is blocked by downstream sandbox slowness (timeouts applied and fallback to pass-through)
Automated tests simulate 10k requests/min with stable duplicate fanout and no memory leak over 1 hour

monitoring: Alert: duplication_cost_rate > 2x expected over 5m -> P1 oncall notify to infra-costs
Alert: duplicate_error_rate > 0.5% -> open incident and auto-disable duplication for affected tenant
Logging: audit event for every credit deduction and duplication stop reason
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal-only sandboxes, enable duplication for platform-team tenants with high observability
Phase 1: opt-in beta for 5 external customers (low traffic) with explicit credit grants
Phase 2: gradual enablement across canaries (10% sampled) for runtime-1.22 rollouts
Emergency: admin kill-switch will set global duplication_enabled=false and quarantines list for tenant isolation
risks: Unbounded cost if sampling mis-configured or credits not enforced (mitigation: hard cutover in ledger and billing export)
PII leakage risk into sandboxes (mitigation: redaction hooks + tenant opt-out + sandbox ACLs)
Backpressure causing increased production latency if fanout code is blocking (mitigation: non-blocking fanout and bounded queue)
Complexity of streaming duplication for long-lived streams (mitigation: prototype batching and early termination policy)
